rules.name: Tight base breakout
rules.how: uptrend (50 day over 200 day average), 15 quiet days in a range under 15% on drying volume, then a close above that range on 2x volume in the top quarter of the day; buy next open, stop at the range low (risk 5% or less), out after 10 sessions
rules.why: too few trades (20 older, 17 newer; 20 each needed)

rules.name: Holds up while the market falls
rules.how: S&P 500 down 3%+ over 5 days while the stock is down under 1% (or up) on 1.5x volume; next day the market is up and the stock breaks the previous high; stop at the 5 day low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the older half; profit factor 1.18; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days

rules.name: Second day after a big up day
rules.how: day 0 up 10%+ on 5x volume, closed in the top quarter; day 1 holds above day 0 low, not down over 3%, on less volume; buy a break of the day 1 high on day 2, stop at the day 1 low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the older half; average under zero at 0.8% cost; profit factor 0.93; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; not clearly better than a random stock

rules.name: Strict high tight flag
rules.how: up 20%+ on 5x volume, then 3 to 5 quiet days in a range of 12% or less on falling volume with no down day over 4%; buy a break of the quiet high on 2x volume, stop at the quiet low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: 20 day high, quality version
rules.how: close at a 20 day high on 2x volume in the top quarter of the day, price 10 USD+, S&P 500 above its 50 day average; buy next open if not 5% above the close, stop at the 10 day low or 2 daily moves (the closer), target 2x the risk, out after 10 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Fast mover continuation (next day breaks the jump-day high)
rules.how: up 20%+ on 2x the volume of the 5 days before, closed in the top third of the day; the NEXT day only if it trades above the jump-day high (skip if it opens over 1% above that), stop at the jump-day low or 2 daily moves under the entry (the higher), stop no wider than 18%, target 2.5x the risk, out after 3 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Undercut and reclaim (dips under yesterday’s low, closes back above it)
rules.how: uptrend (above the 200 day average, 50 over 200), 5 USD+, 2M USD+ traded; the day trades under the previous day’s low but closes back above it, in the top half of its range; the NEXT day only if it trades above that day’s high (skip if it opens over 1% above it); stop just under the undercut low, no wider than 12%, target 1.5x the risk, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Volume build-up near the high
rules.how: chosen on the older half from 96 versions: last 5 days’ volume 3x the 20 days before, 5 day change +0% to +18%, close within 5% of the 25 day high, price 20 USD or less; buy next open, stop -10%, target +20%, out after 8 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

HUNTING LAB, 2026-10-09
8 new ways to catch moves, each a complete trade, tested on the whole US market 2021-10-12 to 2026-10-09 (collapsed stocks included), 0.8% cost. Rules fixed in advance (the build-up version is chosen on the older half only); each must pass in BOTH halves.

NOT PROVEN: Tight base breakout
  older half: 20 trades, 15% won, average -5.8%, profit factor 0.08
  newer half: 17 trades, 6% won, average -5.3%, profit factor 0.07, stopped out 29%
  too few trades (20 older, 17 newer; 20 each needed)
NOT PROVEN: Holds up while the market falls
  older half: 1182 trades, 36% won, average -0.9%, profit factor 0.66
  newer half: 663 trades, 48% won, average +0.4%, profit factor 1.18, stopped out 13%
  lost money in the older half; profit factor 1.18; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days
NOT PROVEN: Second day after a big up day
  older half: 270 trades, 37% won, average -0.8%, profit factor 0.80
  newer half: 226 trades, 38% won, average -0.3%, profit factor 0.93, stopped out 37%
  lost money in the older half; average under zero at 0.8% cost; profit factor 0.93; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; not clearly better than a random stock
REJECTED: Strict high tight flag
  older half: 21 trades, 33% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.77
  newer half: 22 trades, 18% won, average -2.2%, profit factor 0.44, stopped out 23%
  lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
REJECTED: 20 day high, quality version
  older half: 4400 trades, 43% won, average -0.8%, profit factor 0.78
  newer half: 4817 trades, 39% won, average -1.0%, profit factor 0.77, stopped out 37%

REJECTED: Fast mover continuation (next day breaks the jump-day high)
  older half: 496 trades, 43% won, average -0.2%, profit factor 0.96
  newer half: 623 trades, 42% won, average -1.1%, profit factor 0.75, stopped out 21%

  lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
REJECTED: Volume build-up near the high
  version: chosen on the older half from 96 versions: last 5 days’ volume 3x the 20 days before, 5 day change +0% to +18%, close within 5% of the 25 day high, price 20 USD or less; buy next open, stop -10%, target +20%, out after 8 sessions
  older half: 439 trades, 41% won, average -0.7%, profit factor 0.79
  newer half: 467 trades, 41% won, average -1.3%, profit factor 0.69, stopped out 25%
  lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

Buying a random stock for 10 days, newer half: 146842 trades, 43% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.85.

EXIT TEST on the same quick-dip entries (24034 + 27229 trades)
  current exit (5 day average or 5 days): older 24034 trades, 49% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.66 | newer 27229 trades, 51% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.75
  take half at +1 daily move, let the rest run (trailing stop, up to 30 days): older 24034 trades, 50% won, average -1.0%, profit factor 0.63 | newer 27229 trades, 53% won, average -0.9%, profit factor 0.69
  RESULT: KEEP THE CURRENT QUICK EXIT.

No new way passed. Nothing to act on. The lab repeats every Sunday as new days come in.
Not tested here (no history to test on): Reddit or YouTube mentions plus a breakout, and news-tag rules. Those are scored forward instead (sources, movers journal).
Daily prices only; fills at the open or the stated level are assumed. Research, not an order. Not financial advice, not a halal ruling.
